items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Sure, I remember Glover Compton. But he spent quite a few years in Europe. You know, he was a piano player.

ctx.x: Sure, I remember Glover Compton. But he spent quite a few years in Europe. You know, he was a piano player. But now he... At least I don't know if he's living. And he was in New Orleans. He'd open the lounge there on 51st Street. Mm-hmm.
Do you remember the Clock of Time? A tune called The Clock of Time?
